name: מֵי זָהָב
summary: An Edomite, father of Matred and grandfather of Mehetabel, the wife of Hadar (Hadad), the last of the kings who reigned in Edom before any king reigned over Israel (Gen 36:39; 1Ch 1:50). The name is מֵי “waters of” with זָהָב “gold”; scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “His wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of מֵי זָהָב.”
The same line in the list of Edom's kings.
זָהָב “gold”, the second part of the name.

note: Takes m.bt.ab. BDB's key is counted by spelling on every unpointed זָהָב token, so its token count is inflated; the person is named only at Gen 36:39 and 1Ch 1:50. Whether מֵי זָהָב names a place (as דִּי זָהָב, Deu 1:1) used as a personal name, and whether “daughter of” here means descendant or a place of origin, scripture does not say; TIPNR records Mezahab as a man.
